name: wechat-macos-send
description: Send one explicitly authorized WeChat message from macOS with local recipient and draft verification.

interface.shortDescription: Send one verified WeChat message from your Mac
interface.longDescription: Send a single explicitly authorized WeChat message through an authorized Mac. Requires the Remote Desktop Commander plugin and the local WeChat helper installed on that Mac.
defaultPrompt: Send a WeChat message to a contact on my Mac.
Send this exact message to a WeChat group on my Mac.
